name: Bolador Tours
summary: Bolador Tours is a family business run by Geoff and Sharon Coyle, with two catamarans: Bolador, a 57ft catamaran built in Barbados, and Imagine, a 42ft leisure catamaran. Shared cruises are kept to small groups and visit the shipwrecks to snorkel and swim with turtles, with hotel transfers and an open bar included. Both boats are also available for private charters.
standouts: Bolador was designed and built in Barbados and launched on 31 August 1989
Shared cruises capped at 18 guests on Bolador and 14 on Imagine
Transfers to and from the catamaran included on shared cruises
Family owned by Geoff and Sharon Coyle
